component.name: Zero Browser
component.summary: A minimal, fast browser built with Flutter

description.p: Zero Browser is a minimal data-driven web browser. It simplifies web browsing by focusing on data-driven interchange and eliminating complexity of traditional HTML/CSS/JS-based systems.
Features include tab management, history tracking, bookmark support, and rich text rendering with markdown, comments, tables, lists, and grids.
Initial release featuring tab management, history tracking, bookmark support, and rich markdown rendering with comments, tables, and data-driven content display.
